t3.text: 3 · Default unit on the equipment row

s1.text: Tap + on 20 kg: the next heavier weight in Dumbbell's groups by true weight is 45 lb (20 kg is about 44.1 lb). Order around it: 42.5 lb, 20 kg, 45 lb, 47.5 lb, 50 lb, 24 kg. Only the number and its unit label change.

s2.text: Changing a group's unit only relabels its numbers, so there's no confirmation. In lb, ranges step in whole pounds or 2.5 lb and the preset tiles are in lb.
